t: Bloodied Legendary mod (Fallout 76) | Fallout Wiki | Fandom
s: March 14, 2024 - Bloodied is a first star weapon legendary mod in Fallout 76, introduced in the Milepost Zero update. When applied to a legendary weapon, it provides a steadily increasing Damage bonus the lower the player's health. Mod boxes have a 1.5% chance to be received from scrapping a Bloodied legendary item.

t: Bloodied | D&D4 Wiki | Fandom
s: A character is bloodied when the character's hit points are equal to or less than one-half the character's maximum hit points, rounded down. One-half the character's maximum hit points, rounded down, is referred to as the character's bloodied value.
